column1: # NASSP mission edits: per milestone, the tolerance |ours - stock| may reach for each numeric
# column of the edit CSVs (common.lua's ac.edits: vessel truth from Orbiter, CMC/LGC words), at
# the same time since ignition (entry: since 400,000 ft), from ignition on.
# Rule (lead, 2026-10-13): every numeric column, exactly 1.5 x the stock run's own spread (stock
# headless -f 0.02 against stock headless -f 0.01, same scenario and script), no rounding, no hand
# choice. Rows are the output of `tools/nassp_edits.py --derive <runs> <milestone>` and are
# frozen before the dev run of that milestone is compared; a change repeats the stock runs and is
# logged in docs/modules/nassp-integration.md "Test changes". A column with stock spread 0 (e.g.
# liftoff eng) has tolerance 0. Euler angles near pitch 90 (liftoff bank / yaw) spread ~180 deg in
# stock alone: their rows judge little; the CDU columns carry the attitude.
# Derived 2026-10-13 from runs ref_pdi_H / ref_pdi_H01 and ref_liftoff_H / ref_liftoff_H01.
